rows.question: 查询所有 eSIM 套餐的名称和价格
rows.gold_sql: SELECT plan_name, price FROM plans
rows.gen_sql:
SELECT p.name AS 套餐名称, p.price AS 价格
FROM plans p
WHERE p.type = 'esim'
LIMIT 1000

rows.question: 查询所有已激活的用户档案
rows.gold_sql: SELECT * FROM esim_profiles WHERE status = 'active'
rows.gen_sql:
SELECT 
    u.id AS 用户ID,
    u.phone_number AS 手机号码,
    u.email AS 邮箱,
    u.iccid AS ICCID,
    u.imsi AS IMSI,
    u.mvno_id AS MVNO_ID,
    u.status AS 用户状态,
    u.region AS 地区,
    u.created_at AS 创建时间,
    u.updated_at AS 更新时间
FROM users u
WHERE u.status = 'active'
LIMIT 1000

rows.question: 列出价格大于 50 元的套餐
rows.gold_sql: SELECT * FROM plans WHERE price > 50
rows.gen_sql:
SELECT id AS 套餐ID, name AS 套餐名称, data_volume_mb AS 数据流量MB, voice_minutes AS 语音分钟数, sms_count AS 短信条数, price AS 价格, currency AS 货币, validity_days AS 有效期天数, type AS 套餐类型, status AS 状态
FROM plans
WHERE price > 50
LIMIT 1000

rows.question: 查询所有处于漫游状态的套餐包
rows.gold_sql: SELECT * FROM roaming_packages WHERE status = 'active'
rows.gen_sql:
SELECT 
    rp.id,
    rp.name AS 套餐名称,
    rp.coverage_countries AS 覆盖国家,
    rp.data_volume_mb AS 数据量MB,
    rp.price AS 价格,
    rp.currency AS 货币,
    rp.validity_days AS 有效期天数,
    rp.mvno_id AS MVNO_ID,
    rp.status AS 状态
FROM roaming_packages rp
WHERE rp.status = 'active'
LIMIT 1000

rows.question: 查询每个订单对应的用户名和套餐名
rows.gold_sql: SELECT o.id, u.username, p.plan_name FROM orders o JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.id JOIN plans p ON o.plan_id = p.id
rows.gen_sql:
SELECT 
    o.id AS 订单ID,
    o.order_no AS 订单编号,
    u.name AS 用户名,
    p.name AS 套餐名
FROM orders o
LEFT JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.id
LEFT JOIN plans p ON o.plan_id = p.id
LIMIT 1000

rows.question: 查询每个用户的 eSIM 档案状态和用户名
rows.gold_sql: SELECT u.username, e.status FROM users u JOIN esim_profiles e ON u.id = e.user_id
rows.gen_sql:
SELECT 
    u.id AS 用户ID,
    u.phone_number AS 手机号,
    u.email AS 邮箱,
    e.profile_status AS eSIM档案状态,
    e.iccid AS ICCID,
    e.imsi AS IMSI,
    e.activation_code AS 激活码,
    e.activated_at AS 激活时间
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN esim_profiles e ON u.id = e.user_id
ORDER BY u.id
LIMIT 1000

rows.question: 统计每个套餐的订单数量
rows.gold_sql: SELECT p.plan_name, COUNT(o.id) FROM plans p LEFT JOIN orders o ON p.id = o.plan_id GROUP BY p.plan_name
rows.gen_sql:
SELECT p.name AS 套餐名称, COUNT(o.id) AS 订单数量
FROM plans p
LEFT JOIN orders o ON p.id = o.plan_id
GROUP BY p.id, p.name
ORDER BY 订单数量 DESC
LIMIT 1000

rows.question: 查询购买了尊享版套餐的用户邮箱
rows.gold_sql: SELECT u.email FROM users u JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id JOIN plans p ON o.plan_id = p.id WHERE p.plan_name LIKE '%尊享%'
rows.gen_sql:
SELECT u.email AS 用户邮箱
FROM orders o
INNER JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.id
INNER JOIN plans p ON o.plan_id = p.id
WHERE p.name = '尊享版'
  AND o.status = 'paid'
LIMIT 1000

rows.question: 查询每个运营商提供的套餐数量
rows.gold_sql: SELECT op.operator_name, COUNT(p.id) FROM operators op LEFT JOIN plans p ON op.id = p.operator_id GROUP BY op.operator_name
rows.gen_sql:
SELECT 
    o.name AS 运营商名称,
    COUNT(p.id) AS 套餐数量
FROM operators o
LEFT JOIN plans p ON o.id = p.mvno_id
GROUP BY o.id, o.name
ORDER BY 套餐数量 DESC
LIMIT 1000

rows.question: 统计每种订单状态的订单数量

rows.gen_sql:
SELECT status AS 订单状态, COUNT(*) AS 订单数量
FROM orders

LIMIT 1000

rows.question: 计算所有套餐的平均价格

rows.gen_sql:

rows.question: 查询总销售额最高的套餐
rows.gold_sql: SELECT p.plan_name, SUM(o.amount) FROM plans p JOIN orders o ON p.id = o.plan_id GROUP BY p.plan_name ORDER BY SUM(o.amount) DESC LIMIT 1
rows.gen_sql:
SELECT p.name AS 套餐名称, SUM(o.amount) AS 总销售额
FROM orders o
JOIN plans p ON o.plan_id = p.id
WHERE o.status = 'paid'
GROUP BY p.id, p.name
ORDER BY 总销售额 DESC
LIMIT 1

rows.question: 查询购买了尊享版套餐的用户邮箱
rows.gold_sql: SELECT u.email FROM users u JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id JOIN plans p ON o.plan_id = p.id WHERE p.plan_name LIKE '%尊享%'
rows.gen_sql:
SELECT u.email AS 用户邮箱
FROM users u
JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id
JOIN plans p ON o.plan_id = p.id
WHERE p.name = '尊享版'
  AND o.status IN ('paid', 'activated')
GROUP BY u.id, u.email
ORDER BY u.email
LIMIT 1000
